subject.title: [Feature]: Everything is a cron — unify heartbeat, watchers, and scheduled automation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt cron as the canonical automation primitive and sponsor the proposed staged migration of heartbeat configuration and HEARTBEAT.md into persistent job state?
rationale: The proposal is a large core-architecture and compatibility decision: it changes public configuration, persisted state, delivery/session guarantees, and the execution surface rather than repairing an established bug.

options.title: Sponsor a phased unification RFC
options.body: Define compatibility invariants and doctor migrations first, then land one narrow phase at a time with upgrade proof.

options.title: Limit the work to adaptive heartbeat cadence
options.body: Honor bounded next-check proposals without merging heartbeat storage or semantics into cron yet.

options.title: Retain distinct primitives
options.body: Keep heartbeat and cron separate and address shared shortcomings through targeted APIs or documentation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a phased unification RFC
recommendation.body: Define compatibility invariants and doctor migrations first, then land one narrow phase at a time with upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects steipete to both cron and heartbeat scheduling behavior, and the issue is explicitly labeled for maintainer handling.
